properties.label: Threshold and state transition
properties.definition: The application applies the configured threshold and transitions its motion state for the accepted observation sequence.

properties.label: Visible UI representation
properties.definition: The observable UI represents the resulting application state and completed motion interval.

properties.label: BLE discovery
properties.definition: The configured peripheral is discovered through the executed BLE route.

properties.label: BLE connection
properties.definition: The application and configured peripheral establish the BLE link used by the execution.

properties.label: GATT subscription
properties.definition: The application subscribes to the configured GATT notification characteristic before stimulus.

properties.label: Notification delivery
properties.definition: The configured observation is transmitted as a BLE notification and received on the application side of the boundary.

properties.label: BLE payload decoding
properties.definition: The application decodes the received BLE payload into the semantic observation consumed by its state model.

claims.proposition: Configured accepted observations produce the expected threshold, application-state, and visible-UI behavior.
claims.assuranceTarget: Application state model and visible UI

claims.proposition: A configured BLE notification traverses and is accepted at the BLE/application boundary.
